quarter.zh: 2026 财年第四季（9 月季度）

en: Adjusted EPS of $3.88 (+16%) beat the ~$3.70 consensus, but sales of $2.33B (+1%, 3% organic) missed $2.41B because Rockwell refunded tariff-related price increases to customers; excluding that and the Sensia exit, core sales grew 7%. The FY27 adjusted EPS guide of $14.50–15.50 roughly matches the ~$14.9 consensus. CEO Blake Moret pointed to semiconductor and data center, now about 10% of sales and seen growing mid-teens; CFO Christian Rothe guided Q1 EPS near $3.00 and capex up to about 4% of sales.

Shares were down about 8.5% before the open, opened at $402.96 and kept sliding through the call to close down 14.2% at $381.05, one of the worst days in years and the lowest close since April. Investors looked past the tariff explanation to a guide that barely beat consensus on a stock near 30 times forward earnings, plus a soft first quarter and cost inflation. Industrials also fell as traders rotated out of AI-linked names.
zh: 经调整每股收益 3.88 美元（+16%）高于约 3.70 美元的预期，但销售额 23.3 亿美元（+1%，内生增长 3%）低于 24.1 亿美元预期，原因是公司向客户退还了与关税相关的涨价；剔除这一因素及退出 Sensia，核心销售增长 7%。FY27 经调整每股收益指引 14.50–15.50 美元，与约 14.9 美元的预期基本一致。CEO 布雷克·莫雷特强调半导体与数据中心业务，目前约占销售 10%，预计增长十几个百分点；CFO 克里斯蒂安·罗特预计第一季每股收益约 3.00 美元，资本开支升至销售的约 4%。
股价盘前下跌约 8.5%，以 402.96 美元开盘，电话会期间持续走低，收盘下跌 14.2% 至 381.05 美元，为多年来最差单日表现之一，也是 4 月以来最低收盘价。投资者不再接受关税的解释，而是关注到在约 30 倍预期市盈率下，指引仅略高于预期，加上首季偏弱和成本通胀。当天交易员撤出 AI 相关板块，工业股普遍下跌。

bio.en: Joined Rockwell in 1985 straight out of Georgia Tech and has spent his whole career there, running the Control Products & Solutions business before becoming CEO in 2016 and chairman in 2018.
bio.zh: 1985 年从佐治亚理工毕业后加入罗克韦尔，整个职业生涯都在公司度过，曾执掌控制产品与解决方案业务，2016 年出任 CEO，2018 年兼任董事长。

bio.en: CFO since August 2024. Spent the previous 13 years at Graco, the industrial equipment maker, in senior finance and strategy roles; University of Minnesota MBA.
bio.zh: 2024 年 8 月起任 CFO。此前在工业设备制造商固瑞克（Graco）工作 13 年，担任财务与战略要职；明尼苏达大学 MBA。

sources.t: Q4 FY26 results and FY27 guidance
